description: This file implements the Settings class for managing power and display settings, including loading, saving, and default initialization. It defines the SettingsV1 class for version 1 settings, handles file I/O, and manages power state conversions.

classes.name: SettingsV1
classes.description: Handles version 1 of the power management settings, including loading from and saving to files, and initializing default values.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the settings structure minus padding for version 1.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads settings from a file descriptor based on the header information.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves settings to a file descriptor.
